answers.text: Three lines, same order — delivery date, item and quantity, any change from the original order.
List each claim by date, amount, category and submitter.
Something about the dates doesn't sit right in that one, worth checking again.
62 up from 54 works out to about 15%. The on-time rate seems off too, 3 late out of 62 isn't quite 97%.
I'd go with Output 2, it shows where the 4.1% comes from. Output 1 doesn't.
Reply 2, it's got references you can check. Reply 1 doesn't.
I'd be careful with the pricing terms before pasting them anywhere.
Before the report goes to the manager, I'd cross-check the totals against the warehouse system — something that would actually catch a wrong number, not just a typo.
Step 1 matters because a bad read carries through, and step 4's automatic send is where I'd want a gate too.
